proposition: Melvin-Koushki dates the completion of the Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr to Dhū l-Ḥijja 806 (June 1404), presumably in Cairo, but the entry cites no colophon for the date and marks the place as presumption; the Majlis copy (828/1425) is only a later copy.

mediation.who: copyist(s) of MS Majlis 10196, as reported by Melvin-Koushki citing Ḥāʾirī's catalogue

mediation.note: the basis of the 806 date is not given in the entry
